en: A black‑and‑white postcard reproduction of a stone or terracotta Gothic-style sculpture showing the Virgin Mary kneeling and tenderly holding the Christ Child across her lap. Mary wears flowing drapery and a simple crown or headdress, and the background is a plain dark studio backdrop, suggesting the photograph was taken in a museum or church for art‑historical documentation.
